question: What should the first OpenClaw-owned skill permission and trust manifest contract include, and how should declared permissions relate to install/update consent, audit/trust scoring, signing or attestation, ClawHub verification, and runtime enforcement?
rationale: The request changes the skill trust boundary and public metadata contract, and source inspection shows existing scanner and hook seams but no maintainer-approved schema or enforcement model to implement mechanically.

options.title: Consolidate the security design first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical manifest contract and coordinate it with the capability-enforcement, provenance, signing, and ClawHub verification issues before implementation.

options.title: Start with audit-only metadata
options.body: Approve a non-enforcing v0 manifest that only powers inspection and trust reporting, with enforcement/signing deferred to separate issues.

options.title: Move to ClawHub/plugin-only incubation
options.body: Incubate schema and scoring outside core until a missing core enforcement or install-policy API is proven.

recommendation.title: Consolidate the security design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical manifest contract and coordinate it with the capability-enforcement, provenance, signing, and ClawHub verification issues before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history across skills CLI, ClawHub install/trust, and prior review of this issue.
